hypothesis: H1: for waves in the right-tail ledger's own top decile by tape peak_multiple (peak_multiple >= 2.9x, the genuine 'right tail' this instrument exists to measure), a FINITE increase to the runner target and/or a wider give-back trail would capture a materially larger share of the tape's own peak_multiple, net of the give-back it costs on the OTHER waves in the same population that reverse before the wider target/trail would have exited them -- WITHOUT a net loss when scored over the full right-tail-ledger population (not just the top decile in isolation, which would cherry-pick the waves that happened to run and ignore the ones a wider stop would have bled on).

the_spec.current_shape_under_test: runner_target_pct=2.5x / trail_pct=0.15 (15% off HWM) per CLAUDE.md's doctrine text for the core v15.3 Safe/Bold engine -- the shape this hypothesis proposes to WIDEN. (The fleet RIBBON_RIDE registry entry already runs an effectively unconstrained target per the discrepancy noted above; if a future session confirms the core engine also runs unconstrained/0.125 rather than 2.5x/0.15, THIS hypothesis is moot for that path and only applies wherever a genuine 2.5x/0.15 shape is confirmed live.)
candidate_finite_changes: runner_target_pct: 2.5x -> a fixed alternative in [3.0x, 4.0x] (still FINITE -- explicitly NOT 'remove the cap', which is the C30 dead-knob pattern below)
trail_pct: 0.15 -> a wider alternative in [0.20, 0.25] (give back more room before locking, on the theory that 0.15 off a fresh HWM cuts right-tail waves off before they finish running)
the_spec.instrument: analysis/right-tail/ledger.jsonl (the rolling second-wave/capture_rate roll-up) PLUS its own per-day source, analysis/right-tail/CAPTURE-<date>.json (`waves[].peak_multiple` = tape peak; `arms.<arm>.wave_events[].exit_multiple`/`held_to_tp1`/`runner_ran` = realized exit), produced nightly by setup/scripts/right_tail_capture.py (Gamma_RightTailCapture, R3). This is the SAME instrument the goal names as already-built and reused, not a new one -- T2 files the question against it, T2 does not extend it (T1 is the only producer extension in this goal).
the_spec.unit_of_measure: per wave: tape peak_multiple vs the BEST realized exit_multiple achieved by any arm that took it (matching the join method used in evidence_this_prereg_is_built_on above).

kill_criteria.primary_kill: If, over the right-tail ledger's FULL population (not just the top-peak decile) at n>=20 forward waves post-10-30, the wider target/trail's simulated or forward-shadowed net P&L (winners' extra capture MINUS losers' extra give-back on waves that reverse before the wider shape would exit) is NOT positive at bootstrap CI-lower(2.5%) > 0, the candidate change is KILLED -- the C30 caveat below is exactly this failure mode, and this bar exists so the hypothesis cannot ship on the top-decile's cherry-picked upside alone.
kill_criteria.concentration_kill: If the primary bar's positive result is driven by <3 waves (top3_concentration_share >= 0.60 of the net delta, matching this repo's standing top3_concentration_share convention in fleet_gate_leak_shadow.py/tp1_r50 shadows), the result is a concentration artifact per BACKTESTING-PLAYBOOK.md 2.4 and the candidate is KILLED regardless of the aggregate sign.
kill_criteria.either_kill_closes_the_candidate: Either failure alone is sufficient to kill; both must pass to proceed to a 2026-10-30 checkpoint SHADOW-FILE proposal (a forward shadow instrument, not a live params.json change -- any live change still needs its OWN A/B per this project's standing eval-first gate, CLAUDE.md OP-11).

extend_criterion: If n<20 forward waves exist by 2026-10-30 (right-tail waves clearing WAVE_THRESHOLD=1.3 are inherently rare -- this session's own 5-week pull found only 36), the checkpoint reports UNVERIFIED -- insufficient n, not a negative finding (same convention as prereg-vix-bull-hard-cap-unblock-shadow-2026-09-05.json's extend_criterion) -- and the question stays open past 10-30 rather than being force-closed on thin data.
c30_caveat: CLAUDE.md's Lessons index C30 ('Unconstrained exit targets (runner never hits 5x in 0DTE) = dead knob', L24/148/176/291) is the exact failure mode this prereg is designed NOT to repeat: an UNCONSTRAINED or effectively-infinite runner target is a dead knob because it can never bind (the position exits some other way first, so 'raising' it changes nothing measurable) -- and this session's own read of automation/state/fleet/strategies.py found RIBBON_RIDE's fleet-side runner_target_pct is ALREADY 99.0 (functionally unconstrained), which is precisely a live instance of the C30 pattern, not a control this hypothesis can widen further. This prereg's candidate_finite_changes are therefore bounded to a NAMED FIXED alternative (3.0x-4.0x) and a NAMED wider trail (20-25%), never 'remove the target' or 'let it ride' -- any 10-30 proposal that instead proposes removing the fixed cap is out-of-spec for this filing and must be re-registered as its own prereg with its own kill criteria, because an unconstrained target is unfalsifiable by construction (C30) and cannot be evaluated by this file's kill bar.
what_this_is_NOT: NOT a change to params.json, strategies.py, exit_manager.py, or any FROZEN_TRADING_PATH file -- config freeze holds through 2026-10-30.

NOT a claim that the core safe-2/bold-2 engine currently runs 2.5x/15% -- that is CLAUDE.md's doctrine TEXT; this session found the fleet-side registry entry and one params.json key both disagree with it, and did not resolve which is the actual live core-engine read path (flagged, not chased, per scope discipline).

NOT an evaluation of the fleet arms' RIBBON_RIDE runner_target_pct=99.0 shape specifically -- that is ALREADY a C30 unconstrained-target instance; this hypothesis is about a genuinely FIXED 2.5x-style target, wherever one is confirmed live.
NOT permission to widen anything before 2026-10-30 -- this is a pre-registration, not a proposal to ship.
n_needed: n>=20 forward right-tail waves (peak_multiple >= WAVE_THRESHOLD 1.3, matching this project's standing evidence_n advisory bar) is the PRIMARY bar for the checkpoint read; below that, extend_criterion applies.
